SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF SEP-21-2018 - JUDGMENT.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF DUNLAP-TOLLIVER, WHITNEY SIMONE IS NOT OWED ANY MONEY BY DEFENDANT BARR, KEVIN ALTON MANAGEMENT CORPORATION THIS IS AN UNFORTUNATE CASE, BUT ONLY A LANDLORD (NORTHRIDGE COOPERATIVE) AND NOT A PROPERTY MANAGER IS OBLIGED TO MAKE ARRANGEMENTS FOR RETURN OF ABANDONED PROPERTY. FURTHERMORE, THIS ACTION IS BARRED BY THE STATUTE OF LIMITATIONS, WHICH REQUIRED PLAINTIFF TO FILE SUIT WITHIN THREE YEARS. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS PLAINTIFF'S EXHIBITS RECEIVED
